overview_description.description: iCodejr is a UAE-based edtech academy focused on preparing kids and teens with future-ready digital skills through live online classes and project-based learning. The platform provides personalized courses in coding, robotics, artificial intelligence, game development, app development, web design, and creative technologies for students aged 5–18. iCodejr combines one-on-one mentorship, structured learning pathways, hackathons, and hands-on projects to help students build practical technology skills in an engaging and age-appropriate environment. The academy partners with schools and families across the UAE and globally to deliver modern STEM and AI education aligned with evolving industry trends.
